opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES membership required; open to researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world. PhD students have further criteria. Does not cover salary of principal researcher, bench fees, or direct costs of hiring departmental vehicles. Not a scholarship; cannot fund completion of an undergraduate or master's degree or part of a funded fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership (not required for all group members). Groups of 8-15 individuals, diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation, demonstrating EDI principles.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £30,000 over two years to bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals to focus on data analysis and synthesis, fostering collaboration and mentoring.

opportunities.title: Long-term Research Grants

amount.raw: up to £500 per year for a decade; £3,500 claimable for first five years in year 1

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners, reserve managers, consultants and university academics; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funding over 10 years for long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world, supporting the launch of new long-term studies (e.g. ecological restoration, habitat creation, control of alien species, climate change) with a small amount each year for data collection.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level (early years to life-long learning, formal or informal settings); awarded to individuals, not organisations; projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £5,000 for research informing teaching and learning practices in ecology, improving learners' experience and promoting excellence in teaching.

opportunities.title: Connecting Ecologists with Other Disciplines Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible; awarded to individuals, not organisations; placements up to 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £20,000 for secondments/placements that immerse an ecologist in a distinctly different discipline or sector (another discipline, NGO/charity, public sector, business) to develop interdisciplinary skills.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; projects max 12 months; no restrictions on where applicants come from or carry out work.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £2,000 for independent outreach, public engagement and science communication activities that engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

amount.raw: maximum £500 for in-person events; maximum £250 for virtual conferences/courses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member; must be a PhD student or postgraduate researcher (postdoc researchers, undergraduates and masters students not eligible); work/study at a university or research institution; work in scientific areas within ecology remit.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and the travel costs of presenting their work at workshops and conferences. Next round opens 24 August 2026.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in the Global South; must be travelling from and returning to the Global South country; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; must be at least three years since last BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting 2026 in the UK, covering travel and related costs up to £1,000. Open 17 July 2026 to 8 September 2026.
